entities.name: Sustainability
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The principle that human development should meet present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. Codified by the Brundtland Report (1987), sustainability now drives international policy through the UN Sustainable Development Goals, climate accords, and circular economy models.
